scientific_integrity: The proof is a direct gap-length argument with exact inclusion-exclusion. Full text of the nearest k-mutual-visibility preprint (arXiv version 3) and relevant zero-tolerance work were compared. No independent mathematical audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for finite simple labelled cycles and tolerance one; all-subset counts, not symmetry orbits. The known extremal size is not claimed new; this study supplies fourth- and fifth-order counts and gap characterization. The historical novelty survey may not detect all equivalent prior treatments. The verification enumerates only finite orders; proof covers all orders.
title: Complete one-tolerant mutual-visibility polynomial of cycles
